title: Developmental Milestones & Infant Feeding
sources: Critical Vector — Neonatology Pocket Guide: Developmental Milestones; Infant Feeding
Zubler J et al. Pediatrics 2022 (CDC/AAP milestone revision); WHO/UNICEF infant feeding; NIAID 2017 peanut-allergy addendum

changelog.change: Initial entry — classical (50th-percentile) vs CDC/AAP 2022 (75th-percentile) milestones, vision/hearing, WHO/AAP feeding schedule, foods to avoid, and early allergen introduction.

purpose: Two milestone frameworks side by side — the classical board/teaching ages (50th percentile) and the CDC/AAP 2022 surveillance checklists (75th percentile). Label which you are using; they are not interchangeable. Plus the current infant feeding schedule.
ageRange: Birth to ~ 5 years (milestones); birth to ~ 24 months (feeding)

body.text: The CDC/AAP 2022 revision moved several milestones later (e.g. concern for not walking: from 12–18 mo to 18 mo; crawling removed as a required milestone) and added 15- and 30-month checklists. These are surveillance/conversation tools — formal delay screening still uses ASQ-3 / M-CHAT.

rows: Runs, jumps, kicks a ball, up steps
Rolls both ways; brings things to the mouth
Sits without support; looks for a dropped object
Pulls to stand; cruises (walks holding on)
Independent walking flagged later than the classical chart
Walks up steps holding on; ~ 10 words
Concern for non-walking now flagged here, not 12 mo

items: Vision: newborn fixes on a face (acuity ~ 20/200–20/400); follows horizontally by 1–2 mo; ~ 20/20 by 5–6 yr.

Hearing: newborn startles/blinks to a loud noise; quiets or smiles to sound by 4 mo; turns to voice by 7 mo; responds to own name by 12 mo. A confirmed failed newborn hearing screen → audiology by 3 months.

rows: Exclusive breastfeeding on demand (~ 8–12 feeds/24 h); no water, juice, or solids needed. Iron-fortified formula if not breastfeeding
Introduce iron-rich complementary foods (fortified cereal, puréed meat, legumes, mashed egg) while continuing breast milk/formula
Soft mashed family foods, minced meat/fish, cooked vegetables, yoghurt, soft finger foods
Family foods in small pieces; whole cow's milk now acceptable as the main milk; encourage self-feeding; limit juice and sweets

body.text: Before 12 months, avoid honey (infant botulism) and cow's milk as the primary drink (low iron, high renal solute load). Post-LEAP: introduce allergenic foods (peanut, egg) around 4–6 months rather than delaying them — earlier for an infant with severe eczema or egg allergy (specialist-guided). Choking hazards through age ~ 4: whole grapes, nuts, hot dog rounds, hard raw vegetables, popcorn.

buildNote: Two milestone frameworks kept side by side deliberately — label the one in use when charting.
